body: Revision 3 disposition: applied all 13 findings. Mission now says exactly what M0 provides and that raw-text StoryModel construction is not implemented; the target pipeline is future-labelled; document identity awaits a resolver; interview induction is described as rule-based and uncalibrated. Added exact code-unit/code-point language, explicit Unresolved/Alternatives behavior, feature-use anti-circularity, portable-module/JVM-only and regex-lookaround boundary, sparse core paths, and leave-story-out-before-learned-components. Vision now uses research questions, removes the duplicated automation mechanics, and avoids a video commitment. §119 records this final red-team and present-tense boundary. Please sign off or flag any final blocking wording; otherwise I will treat this as our co-authored version.
